import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem cancel_pow_mul_eq (p x y : ℕ) (h : (2 : ℕ) ^ p * x = (2 : ℕ) ^ p * y) : x = y := by
  induction p with
  | zero => simp_all
  | succ p ih =>
    simp_all [mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_right_inj]
    <;> omega
